svg.title: An identity-confidence weighting travels into the clinic scheduler and rearranges other people's queue.
svg.desc: The seasonal worker's clinic result reconnects, but an amber rule generalises the repair's identity-confidence weighting. It spreads into welfare, school, market and clinic branches, where several unrelated waiting chairs begin to reorder.
svg.text: Page 35, panel 5 · Pull-back from the identity repair into propagation of a network-wide confidence weighting

text.tspan: The clinic result is restored, but the system
generalises the repair into a confidence weighting
that changes scheduler priorities for other people.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
